edition_statement: Samuel Brandt & Georg Laubmann (eds.), L. Caeli Firmiani Lactanti Opera omnia, Part 1, Corpus scriptorum ecclesiasticorum Latinorum (CSEL) 19, Wien: Österreichische Akademie der Wissenschaften, 1890. Digitized by Open Greek and Latin (University of Leipzig, 2014), CC BY-SA 4.0. Source file: OpenGreekAndLatin/csel-dev stoa0171.stoa009.opp-lat1.xml
issues: Source TEI not in PerseusDL/canonical-latinLit (404); fetched from OpenGreekAndLatin/csel-dev master.
Passages segmented as section-ranges within chapters (book.chapter.section, grouped to ~200-2100 chars); range URNs use CTS range syntax e.g. :1.1.1-1.1.6.
61 passages contain embedded Greek (Sibylline oracles, Greek quotations) — legitimate edition text, not contamination; 14 of these are <85% Latin letters.
2 passages keep literal angle brackets from the printed edition's editorial supplement marks as OCR'd ('tra<ditas' in 2.6.7-13, '<cuncta.>' in 7.4.16-19) — verbatim, not TEI leakage.
17 line-break hyphenation artifacts ('xxx- yyy', lowercase both sides) were rejoined (pure dehyphenation, no character changes); uppercase-adjacent cases left untouched.
OCR'd text (Jouve, OGL 2014): residual OCR errors in the source file are preserved verbatim (zero-fabrication).
Epitome Divinarum Institutionum front matter (div subtype='MSS' nested in book 7) excluded — separate work.
Passage length range 221-2081 chars (median 1710); 7 books, 178 chapters, 3274 sections covered with zero text loss vs chapter-level extraction.
